entries.heading: DEFENSE INSPECTOR GENERAL
ancestors: TITLE XV—AUTHORIZATION OF ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATIONS FOR OVERSEAS CONTINGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
SEC. 1508. DEFENSE INSPECTOR GENERAL.

    Funds are hereby authorized to be appropriated for the Department of 
Defense for fiscal year 2019 for expenses, not otherwise provided for, 
for the Office of the Inspector General of the Department of Defense, as 
specified in the funding table in section 4502.
